literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-gospel preparation of-Eusebius treatises fifteen, in which mostly the of-Greeks vain-talk he-refutes, and how discordant themselves with themselves they-remained. He-mentions in beginning of-the fifteenth treatise and in the end of-another treatise, which gospel demonstration he-entitled, consequent being to-the gospel preparation, that the one refutation is nearly of-the of-Greeks error, the other confirmation of-the proclamation of-the-gospel.
source_text: Codex 9 Greek from photius_bibliotheca_greek_lock.txt (Bekker 1824, pp. 4; closeout-4b transcription)
